verdict.rationale: Vestd lists a 'Share certificates' feature and says shares can be issued digitally with no paperwork, alongside a digital cap table that acts as the single source of truth. It also advertises deed/witness signatures in-platform. However, the evidence does not explicitly say that certificates themselves are legally signed in-platform or permanently tied to specific cap table entries. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of electronically signed share certificates, evidence of a certificate-to-cap-table-entry linkage, any detail beyond a feature title, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
